description: The voice scope of Brand expressive: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: voice.count
answers.why: Playful in headlines, plain in errors.

answers.question: voice.definition
answers.why: Principles and examples guide each campaign's writers.

answers.question: voice.lands
answers.why: Words work hardest in headlines and buttons.

usage.use: A short verb that moves: Join, Try, Go
usage.why: Big moments need verbs with energy.

usage.use: Plain first, a light touch after
usage.why: Playful copy must never hide what went wrong.
usage.example: That email doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
You're on the list. See you at launch.

usage.use: Playful, with a clear next step
usage.why: Playful words still need a way forward.
usage.example: Nothing here yet. Go find something you love.

usage.use: Plain. No jokes when something is lost.
usage.why: Loss is never the moment for a joke.
usage.example: Remove this from your list? You can add it back later.

usage.use: One bold line and one button
usage.why: Visitors from a social post give a few seconds.
usage.example: The drop is coming. Be first.

content.$description: Voice tokens: the words components use for common actions. Text, not CSS.

commit.$description: The label of the action that completes a task.

cancel.$description: The label of the way out next to the main action.

destroy.$description: The label of an action that deletes data.

retry.$description: The label that repeats a failed action.

empty-action.$description: The label of the action in an empty state.
